routine_report_policy: IEM report_type=3; within-slot observation timestamp; identical native duplicates deduplicated; multiple distinct times/conflicting versions unresolved; no SPECI pooling
secondary_threshold_reason: Adverse-visibility development sensitivity, includes rain/BR; not a new hazard or independent event. Prior source fixture contains 3SM; exposed and not confirmation.
predicate: native routine visibility strictly less than threshold
units_rule: native exact SM rational times 1609.344; metric native 9999/0000 censoring; no rounded IEM vsby thresholding
neighbor_e_predicate: Any eligible native neighbor routine report in registered last-hour slots has visibility below the same F threshold
evidence_availability: observation time plus declared 5min replay delay; archive does not prove original first-seen; corrected inputs withheld unless issuance provenance available
professional_availability: full native bulletin at archive issuance plus declared 2min replay delay; no archive download time masquerading as historical availability
image_admission: matching 2024 GOES-18 ABI; public pixel/QC and hidden labels separate
outcome_policy: archive final native routine-report reference, conditional on QC and unique-slot admission; missing/conflict/censor-straddle unresolved
E_F_relation: E certification and fixed-predictor F change both reported; neither entails the other
forecast_baseline: complete TAF relevant clauses and separately identified calibrated research projection; no TEMPO point probability
calibration_rule: Laplace-smoothed counts by threshold, native-product issuance-to-target horizon bucket, full-TAF prevailing/conditional threshold categories; sparse cells n<20 back off to no-evidence then threshold pool. Deduplicate each target within each cell.
mapping_identity_reason: Use horizon from native product issuance, so an unchanged target/product does not acquire conflicting baseline probabilities merely because its scoring opportunity has a different lead.
